text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, world! What<n>possibilities will you
reveal to me<n>today?
Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Is something the matter?! I heard a<n>scream come
from over here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, apologies for the commotion! El<n>asked me to
teach her how to do<n>zazen meditation, you see...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Since when did zazen meditation<n>involve
screaming?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, would you mind teaching me<n>as well? I'm
interested to know what<n>kind of meditation had El
screaming<n>like that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl... Turn back now before it's too<n>late! I
couldn't even last five<n>minutes...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Worry not! The more difficult the<n>challenge, the
more I get fired up to<n>show you what's possible!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, close your eyes and try to<n>keep still.
Focus on facing your inner<n>self.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Haha. Even in darkness, my heart is<n>free. I can go
wherever I please!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel the breeze blowing through<n>the palace
gardens.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (I could even walk down a snowy<n>trail.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(I know! What if I use this opportunity<n>to fly around
the world?!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(I can compete in every race that ever<n>was! It
doesn't matter where they<n>are, how long they are,
or even when<n>they took place!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (Oh! So, that's what my possibilities<n>truly are...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Pearl. Please, open your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is it over already?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you didn't move an inch! You<n>were like a
statue!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You have incredible focus. How do<n>you feel?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well... It sort of feels like I've been<n>born again. I
was able to travel<n>around the world and gain some
new<n>insights just now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean you traveled<n>the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. ♪ To put it simply...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have this heart of mine,<n>the
possibilities I possess are<n>limitless!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Grass, you have my thanks! And...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good night, world! ♪ Today, you<n>showed me a
glimpse of what's truly<n>possible.
